scene.text: Traditional Chinese ink-and-watercolour painting: confident dark ink-brush linework, loose expressive brushwork, soft bleeding colour washes, visible paper grain. Faces, hands and skin are built the same way as everything else — flat washes and visible brushstrokes, edges left unresolved where the brush lifted. A wide shot frames two figures on a broad, pale stone staircase in front of a large neoclassical building with columns and ornate stonework. In the foreground, a woman stands with her back to camera, holding an open red umbrella above her head; she wears a sleeveless black evening gown. Several steps above and behind her, a man in a black suit and black shoes faces toward her in a slightly crouched, dynamic stance as though caught mid-movement or reacting to her presence. On-screen text in the upper-left area reads what appears to be a partially visible logo or channel watermark (indistinct lettering). This is a TV commercial.
